# SetGadgetIconStrip

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Toolbars](BlitzPlus-Toolbars)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
SetGadgetIconStrip gadget:Int32, icon_strip:Int32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | Int32 | required | Handle of a list box, combo box or tabber. |
| `icon_strip` | Int32 | required |  |

## Description

Gives a list box, combo box or tabber the icons to use for its entries. Afterwards the icon number given to [AddGadgetItem](AddGadgetItem), [InsertGadgetItem](InsertGadgetItem) or [ModifyGadgetItem](ModifyGadgetItem) picks one.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
strip = CreateImage(32, 16)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(strip)
Color 255, 0, 255 : Rect 0, 0, 32, 16, 1
Color 200, 40, 40 : Rect 2, 2, 12, 12, 1
Color 40, 140, 40 : Oval 18, 2, 12, 12, 1
SaveImage strip, "icons.bmp"
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
win  = CreateWindow("Icons", 10, 10, 300, 150, Desktop(), 3)
list = CreateListBox(10, 10, 200, 90, win)
SetGadgetIconStrip list, LoadIconStrip("icons.bmp")
AddGadgetItem list, "Red square", False, 0
AddGadgetItem list, "Green circle", False, 1
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
